query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing unpredictable solids discharge in our hydrocyclone. Develop a comprehensive diagnostic framework to identify potential root causes.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the hydrocyclone system to identify and analyze factors contributing to inconsistent solids separation performance, and develop a structured troubleshooting methodology to diagnose the underlying issues.

selected_agents.role: Root cause analysis and diagnostic framework development

communication_strategy.information_flow: Systematic data collection and hypothesis testing
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative root cause elimination and diagnostic refinement

clarification_questions: What are the specific characteristics of the solids being separated?
Have there been any recent changes in the feed composition or operating conditions?
Can you provide historical performance data for the hydrocyclone?
